criteria.reason: The verification plan is adequate for this candidate only: it names the exact observable outcome, includes the actual-run success case for a closed Requirements handoff with retained requirements, rejections, owner rulings, source anchors and hashes, and includes a rejection case covering drift, mismatch, unresolved coverage, source drift, and stateful temporary rebuild refusal without mutation. The declaration also requires independent inspection of raw inputs, outputs, rejections and replay records rather than accepting producer conclusions. Whole-sequence readiness and completed execution remain outside this verdict.
